title: Senior Game Developer
description: Senior game developer position focused on architectural leadership, engine-level development, advanced graphics and networking, performance optimization at platform level, and technical mentorship. Expected to lead technical decisions, design enterprise-grade game systems, and drive best practices across the team.

skills.rationale: ECS architecture, custom memory allocators, code generation, and deep systems programming
Engine source modification, custom editor tools, platform abstraction, and cross-platform deployment strategy
GPU frame analysis, platform-specific tuning, build optimization, and performance leadership
Custom render pipelines, ray tracing, GPU optimization, and advanced shader techniques
Procedural generation, spatial partitioning, numerical simulation, and advanced algorithm design
Dedicated server architecture, netcode optimization, and large-scale multiplayer systems
GOAP architecture, AI directors, ML integration, and advanced AI system design
Monorepo strategies, build automation pipelines, release management, and team workflow design
Complex systems design, accessibility architecture, and live ops strategy

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is the sum of weighted scores divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Not at senior level; needs significant growth in architecture and depth

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Some senior skills emerging, but needs more breadth and architectural depth

approaching.description: Strong technical skills, needs to develop leadership and system architecture capabilities

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets expectations for senior game developer position

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
